response.sql:
WITH track_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    m.MediaTypeId,
    m.Name as MediaTypeName,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds > 0 
      THEN CAST(t.Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(t.Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)
      ELSE NULL 
    END as ratio
  FROM Track t
  INNER JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
),
media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    MediaTypeName,
    COUNT(*) as track_count,
    AVG(ratio) as rate
  FROM track_ratios
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId, MediaTypeName
  HAVING COUNT(ratio) > 0
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(rate) as mean_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  m.MediaTypeName,
  m.rate,
  m.track_count,
  m.rate - o.mean_rate
FROM media_type_stats m, overall_stats o
WHERE m.rate > o.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: The 'track_count' in the result refers to the total number of tracks in each media type (COUNT(*)), including those without valid Bytes/Milliseconds values, rather than only tracks that contributed to the rate calculation.

alternatives.interpretation: If 'count its tracks' refers specifically to the tracks used in the rate calculation (those with non-NULL Bytes and Milliseconds > 0), then track_count should use COUNT(ratio) instead of COUNT(*).
